name: section-dots-nav
title: Section dots nav
description: A slim rail of dots down the side of a long page, one per section, each a labelled link that marks where you are.
docs: Pass sections as { id, label } in page order: each becomes a dot linking to #id. The section in view is found with an IntersectionObserver and marked aria-current='location'; the last one takes over at the end of the page. A click scrolls smoothly (instantly under reduced motion) and moves focus to the section. offset is the height of a fixed header, side is 'left' or 'right', label names the navigation, and scrollContainer is a CSS selector for the element that scrolls when it is not the window. The rail is hidden below lg, where AnchorNav or a menu does the job. linkAs renders the dots with your router's Link.
